title: ROYAL REWARD VAULT & CARGO MISSIONS
message: A huge content update is here! Build trains in the Royal Vault, request special freight deliveries, and earn coins even while away from your station.
points: 🚂 Royal Reward Vault: Assemble real express trains coach-by-coach and dispatch them down the track to earn huge coin bundles!
📦 Request Special Cargo Rakes: Call in heavy freight trains at your sidings to unlock surprise tycoon loot manifests.
🌙 Offline Station Earnings: Welcome back rewards! Your station now continues to work and generate revenue while you're offline.
⚡ Smoother Station Operations: Upgraded animations, cleaner menus, and overall performance fixes for seamless train management.

title: NEW TUTORIAL & GAME GUIDE
message: We've added a brand-new, easy-to-follow Game Guide! Learn how to manage train signals, handle VIP passengers, and boost your earnings.
points: 📖 Interactive Game Guide: Learn step-by-step how to route trains, clear signals, and manage lounges with ease.
🎟️ Easy Station Rules: Visual guides explaining ticket queues, VIP order manifests, and non-stop express train handling.
⚙️ Re-watch Anytime: Need a refresher? Access the full game manual anytime directly from the Settings menu!

title: CRITICAL FIX: NON-STOP TRAIN BUG
message: We've fixed an urgent issue where non-stop trains were failing to stop at stations. Please update now to continue playing smoothly!
points: 🚂 Non-Stop Train Fixed: Trains will now properly obey stops and signals as intended.
⚡ Essential Fixes: Critical background stability improvements to keep your railway running seamlessly.

title: PRO LIFETIME PASS & ANIMATION FIXES
message: Key stability improvements for train movement rendering, brand new lifetime ad-free pass, and system update logs.
points: 👑 Official Pro Lifetime Pass: Unlock 100% Ad-Free privilege across all train halts, ticket multipliers, and retiring suites!
🚂 Smooth Train Animations: Fixed visual stuttering and frozen train movement frames across all tracks.
📜 System Update Logs: Added the 'What's New & Updates' dialog to track patch notes and new features in real time.
⚡ Dispatch Terminal Stability: Performance enhancements and UI optimizations across all station hubs.
